verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of no-code automation is thin: Notion markets Custom Agents that "keep work moving 24/7" and "Notion Skills," which are pages of plain-language instructions for a repeatable workflow. The rest of the pack (REST API, webhooks, PATs, internal connections for "custom automations") are developer building blocks requiring code and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented native no-code automation builder (triggers, conditions, multi-step actions), evidence that PMs can chain steps without code, and independent/hands-on corroboration of agent-driven workflows.
